dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors and administrative entities of the designated sites in Natchez, Mississippi, and the Mississippi Department of Archives and History.
dimensions.evidence: The Grand Village of the Natchez Indians in Natchez, Mississippi... Historic Jefferson College in Natchez, Mississippi

dimensions.assessment: Designates sites as affiliated areas with technical and cooperative assistance while expressly barring federal property acquisition or operational funding.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section authorizes the Secretary--(1) to acquire property at the affiliated areas; or (2) to assume financial responsibility for the operation, maintenance, or management

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the Secretary to provide financial assistance through cooperative agreements, but explicitly prohibits assuming operational financial responsibility.
dimensions.evidence: may provide technical assistance to, and enter into cooperative agreements with, the management entity for the purpose of providing financial assistance

dimensions.assessment: Establishes two new affiliated areas of the National Park System under specific management and cooperative agreements.
dimensions.evidence: established as an affiliated area of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Permanent establishment of the affiliated areas status.
dimensions.evidence: established as an affiliated area of the National Park System

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts for cooperative financial assistance are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes the Grand Village of the Natchez Indians and Historic Jefferson College in Natchez, Mississippi, as affiliated areas of the National Park System without federal property acquisition or operational financial responsibility.
